nodes.title: Shoe side load to failure
nodes.procedure: Spare shoe bonded on a stepped foam-board offcut (as T-D5-PROOF), insert pushed 4.5 mm in; load the pad sideways along +y, then a second shoe along +z, in 5 N steps to failure; record the load and where it cracks (rim, window end, roof). Pass: failure load >= 1.5 x CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-LOAD.
